description: Look up one specific product by name or identifier: a product name such as 'Sony WH-1000XM5' or 'Ninja AF101 air fryer', an ASIN, a UPC/EAN/GTIN, or brand plus model number. match reports the result: 'exact' (identifier hit), 'likely' (one clear name match; interpretation.runner_up names the next best), 'ambiguous' (several fit; rows lists the candidates, best first), or 'none' (not carried; the miss is recorded as demand). On exact or likely, products[0] is the full detail (all specs, review-derived ratings with evidence quotes, every seller offer with buy_url), and shelf_context gives its rank on its category shelf by value and quality, its variants (colorways, sizes), and up to three higher-scoring alternatives in the same price band. A product with no live price or image is still returned, flagged under readiness; its price is not current. Responses that carry buy_url links also carry a disclosure field: the commission disclosure for those links.

category.description: Restrict the name match to one Swervie category (exact name).

identifiers.description: Known identifiers. mpn/model_number need brand to resolve.

query.description: The product's name as the shopper said it: brand, model, name. May contain an ASIN or barcode.

user_signature.description: Optional opaque, stable, pseudonymous user id: the shopper's own rate-limit quota and click attribution. Format: 'sv1-' + the first 24 hex characters of SHA-256('swervie/v1|' + normalized identifier), or 'sv1r-' + a UUID. A raw email or phone number is hashed server-side before anything is stored.

name: lookup_product
title: Look up a specific product
